title: On the Unification of Optimal Current Reference Theory for Wound Rotor Synchronous Machines
summary: Controllers for motor drives typically require a current reference which will satisfy the requested torque subject to system constraints. This work generalizes existing current reference theory to the case of the Wound Rotor Synchronous Machine (WRSM).
